C0220.title: Chain Supermarket Colludes to Defraud E-Commerce Platform of Over 1.2 Million Yuan
C0220.summary: In March 2025, Yang, Dai, and other operators of Shanghai-based chain “H Supermarket,” together with related franchise-store managers, organized offline supermarket staff to conduct fake transactions on an e-commerce platform using an “order A, deliver B” method. They placed online orders for subsidized product A while delivering lower-priced product B offline, placing empty orders, or fabricating addresses, thereby defrauding the platform and brands of subsidies involving more than 1.2 million yuan.
